osps_qa_04_02_justification: No release exists, so no released asset is built from another repository.
osps_qa_06_02_justification: Not yet: no document describes the test environments and how the tests run.
osps_qa_06_03_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests -- organization default: add tests for new behaviour and a regression test for a fix.
osps_qa_07_01_justification: The `main` ruleset requires one approving review from someone other than the author, with code-owner review, last-push approval and stale approvals dismissed, and no bypass actors.
osps_sa_03_02_justification: Not yet: no threat model or attack-surface analysis has been written.
osps_vm_04_02_justification: Not yet: no OpenVEX document is published, and no release exists.
osps_vm_05_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependency-and-code-scanning-findings -- Dependency Review fails a pull request that adds a dependency with a high or critical vulnerability or a license outside the allow-list.
osps_vm_05_02_justification: Not yet: SECURITY.md does not say that a dependency finding must be fixed before a release.
osps_vm_05_03_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/.github/workflows/dependency-review.yml fails a pull request on a high-severity finding and runs on every pull request; the `Dependency Review` check is required on main.
osps_vm_06_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/SECURITY.md#dependency-and-code-scanning-findings -- CodeQL fails a pull request on a new alert of error severity or critical or high security severity.
osps_vm_06_02_justification: CodeQL default setup analyzes every push and pull request, and the CodeQL check is required on main.
osps_br_01_03_justification: Pull-request workflows hold no publish credentials: the only secrets they read are the GitHub token and GITLEAKS_LICENSE (https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/.github/workflows/gitleaks.yml); the release secrets are used only by https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml, which runs on pushes to main.
osps_do_07_01_justification: https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/README.md#getting-started -- `pnpm install` and `pnpm verify`; `pnpm build` is in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/package.json.
osps_br_01_04_justification: Collaborator input reaches a shell only through env vars: the pull-request title in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/.github/workflows/commit-lint.yml and the author and commit ids in https://github.com/monte3l/m3l-blueprinter/blob/main/.github/workflows/dco.yml.
